name: ANSI/IEEE Three-wire ultrasonic sensor form
summary: IEEE-library form of three-wire ultrasonic sensor: this representation distinguishes a three-wire ultrasonic sensor interface from a simple contact depiction.
description: This reference locates three-wire ultrasonic sensor in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented ultrasonic switches family. This representation distinguishes a three-wire ultrasonic sensor interface from a simple contact depiction. The public library uses HPX11U3 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
